items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I even did one or two for Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: But now, you said when you went back with Casa Loma the last time, you were hired -- you were more
Now, what happened here, from the time I got out of the Whiteman band, and I did -- I did arrange-ments for Casa Loma. I did some for Fletcher. I even did one or two for Duke Ellington.
